dish: Espresso and from-scratch bakery, plus a Wisconsin artisan-cheese case
w: 'Oregon's living room' since 2000, in a former grocery; now run by Wisconsin Cheese Originals founder Jeanne Carpenter with an artisan cheese counter. Silver for Coffee Shop in Best of Madison 2025 and 2026.

dish: Estate wine or hard cider on the drumlin-top patio with a cheese board
address: Waunakee countryside (between Waunakee and Westport), WI
w: Family winery (2017) on a glacial drumlin north of Madison with a 6,400 sq ft tasting room and patio; Best of Madison 2026 silver Wine Bar and bronze Winery; on Brava's Madison-area winery trail.

dish: Hook's 10- (or 20-) year aged cheddar and blues
address: Shake Rag district, Mineral Point, WI 53565
w: Tony and Julie Hook's Mineral Point cheese company (1976), famous for extra-aged cheddars — its 10-year won an American Cheese Society first; profiled by PBS Wisconsin's Wisconsin Foodie and culture magazine; gold Cheese Producer in Best of Madison 2026.

dish: A flight of estate wines with a brick-oven Neapolitan pizza on weekends
w: Hilltop New Glarus winery (2018) with ~30 wines, Green County small plates and weekend live music; Best of Madison winery medals 2023–2026; profiled by Brava and Northwest Quarterly.
